frozen_upstream_trace_dependency.observed_fact: FHIR request tool arguments are produced by safe_llm_call using an explicit model; run_agent also requires an explicit agent strategy.
frozen_upstream_trace_dependency.implication: Observed query/search traces are model-and-strategy dependent and cannot be reproduced truthfully by static SQL, expected resource IDs, or invented deterministic traces.

stage_order_conflict.reason: D2 requires observed governed query-pattern coverage while D2 simultaneously forbids model selection and keeps D3 inactive. A trace-producing model/agent identity is therefore not currently authorized.
stage_order_conflict.recommended_option: preserve the query-trace criterion but move its model-dependent execution to an immediate post-D3/pre-D4 gate after prospective system freeze
